cohort: The study included 328 women (median age 47 years) who experienced urinary tract injuries during gynecological and obstetrical surgeries between January 2018 and October 2023 at four centers.
finding: The study found that iatrogenic bladder injuries (69.2%) were significantly more frequent than iatrogenic ureteral injuries (30.8%) during gynecological and obstetrical surgeries, with most injuries (91.2%) diagnosed intraoperatively.
mod_finding: Cesarean section resulted in significantly more frequent iatrogenic bladder injuries compared to other types of procedures.
